Hardware = all the physical components of a computer — the parts you can touch.
Software = all the programs that tell the physical components what to do.
🔩 Hardware components

💿 Software components

  • System software — the operating system (Windows, macOS, Android).
  • Application software — word processing, spreadsheet, presentation and video editing software.
Hardware and software are complementary. A computing device can only produce useful outputs when both work together.
⭐ The 5 factors when choosing hardware and software
Memory trick: F–C–C–S–A → Funny Cats Can Sing Anything. Those are the five things you must list if the exam says “what must be considered when purchasing hardware and software?”
💾 Storage: HDD vs SSD
When choosing a secondary storage device, the two considerations are space (capacity) and speed.
📏 Data storage units — smallest to largest
bit → byte → kilobyte → megabyte → gigabyte → terabyte
1 byte = 1 character. So the sentence “Hello, what is your name?” needs 25 bytes — because spaces, commas and the question mark are characters too. Count them all!

⚡ Processor speed

  • Everyday functions (writing, browsing): about 1–2 GHz.
  • Gaming: about 3 GHz or more.
  • Processor speed matters because the CPU is the brain of the computer — everything waits for it.

bloques.html_en: A variable is a named box that stores a value. In Scratch you set a variable to a value, and the value can change while the program runs.
🔢 The blocks you must recognise
➖ Example: subtracting two numbers (page 60)
when this sprite clicked
ask What is the first number? and wait
set Number 1 to answer
ask What is the second number? and wait
set Number 2 to answer
set Result to Number 1 − Number 2
say join Result = Result for 2 seconds
Enter 10 then 4 → Sam says Result = 6. The variables are shown in the top left of the stage, and they show the value stored right now.
Watch out: when you click the Green Flag, the variables are reset to 0. That is why Section 1 contains set Number 3 to 0.

➕ Adding three numbers (page 64)

Same idea, but with three ask/set pairs and two addition operators nested inside one set Result to block:
set Result to ( Number 1 + Number 2 ) + Number 3
To add three numbers you place one addition operator inside the set block, then drop a second addition operator into the first blank area.

📐 Sub-routines: Draw Triangle and Draw Square (page 84)

A sub-routine is your own block, made with Make a block in the My Blocks palette. You write the code once and reuse it as many times as you like.
repeat = number of sides  ·  turn = 360 ÷ number of sides
🎨 The Pattern algorithm
when 🏳 clicked
repeat 3
Draw Triangle
move 40 steps
repeat 3
Draw Square
move 40 steps
repeat 3
Draw Triangle
move 40 steps
repeat 2
Draw Square
move 40 steps
That draws 3 triangles, 3 squares, 3 triangles, 2 squares — 11 shapes in a row, spaced 40 steps apart. Try it in the Scratch Lab tab. 🎨
The Pen palette is not shown by default — you add it with the Add Extension icon at the bottom left.

Digital content is anything that can be stored or sent digitally — text, audio, video files, graphics, animations and images.

A server is a computer that provides services on a network. ← learn this sentence word for word.

🗄️ What servers store

  • Photographs and images — so people can share pictures and photo albums.
  • Messages — mainly text, but they can include images and emojis.
  • Websites — the files and data for websites.
  • Email messages — Gmail, Hotmail and Yahoo! Mail store them on servers.
  • Online software — like Google Docs™, used remotely and saved on Google’s servers.
  • Online games — each game generally has its own server.
  • Video content — movies, TV shows, music videos.
  • Audio content — music, podcasts and audio books. Music is the most popular form of audio.

▶️ Streaming
Streaming is when a digital file is sent a few seconds at a time from the server. You can start watching or listening while the rest of the file is still being sent.
The trap: “Streamed content is automatically stored on the user’s device.” → FALSE. It is automatically deleted.
